bio.title: About Dr. Len Tau.
bio.lead: Dr. Len Tau, or Len, as he prefers to be called, practiced dentistry for more than two decades. He knows what it takes to fill a schedule, lead a team, and earn patient trust, because he did it himself.
paragraphs: Dentistry runs in his family. His father ran a dental office in New City, New York. Len earned his undergraduate degree at Tulane University and his DMD from Tufts University School of Dental Medicine in 1999. He completed his Advanced Education in General Dentistry residency at UMDNJ.

Len owned the Pennsylvania Center for Dental Excellence outside Philadelphia. He sold the practice in 2021 and retired from clinical care in 2022. By then, his patients had left more than 2,000 five-star reviews.

He saw early that online reviews would change how patients choose a dentist. He built iSocial Reviews, which Birdeye acquired. Today he leads the dental division at Birdeye and runs Tau Dental Consulting. Dentists across the country know him as The Reviews Doctor.

Len hosts the Raving Patients Podcast, now in its eighth season. Listeners voted it the 2025 Fan Favorite Dental Podcast. He shares practice growth content with more than 50,000 followers on Instagram. In 2026, USA Dental Report named him one of the 100 key opinion leaders in dentistry. He has written three books and founded Supercharge, an annual conference for practice owners and their teams. He lives in Parkland, Florida.
